description: Removes permissions the game no longer needs, such as phone and accounts, along with the dead services that needed them.
name: Remove unused permissions

description: Makes the menus, text and pictures full size on screens above 720p, where they are otherwise small. The game is drawn at 720p and stretched to the screen, so it looks slightly blurry.
name: Render at 720p

description: Removes the stutter while firing, caused by the game building a new audio player for every sound.
name: Smooth sound

description: Removes the 30 second wait on the loading screen and the daily offline message, and stops the game from contacting Tapjoy, OpenFeint and Glu's dead servers.
name: Stop requests to dead servers

description: A fresh install starts with 999,999,999 Glu credits and 999,999,999 Cash. If you install the patched app as an update, your current balance stays as it is.
name: Unlimited currency

description: Redirects Zotero's sync API and live-update stream to your own server.
name: Custom sync server

options.description: HTTPS origin of your self-hosted Zotero server, for example https://zotero.example.org. Only the host (with an optional port) is accepted: no path and no trailing slash. A missing scheme is assumed to be https://.
options.title: Server address

options.description: Full WebSocket URL for live updates, for example wss://zotero.example.org/stream or ws://zotero.example.org/stream. A path is allowed. Leave empty to derive it from the server address as wss://<server>/stream.
options.title: Streaming address (optional)

description: Adds the chosen streaming host to the app's cleartext allow-list when the stream URL is ws:// or http://.
name: Custom sync server: allow cleartext streaming

options.description: HTTPS origin of your self-hosted Zotero server, for example https://zotero.example.org. Only the host (with an optional port) is accepted: no path and no trailing slash. A missing scheme is assumed to be https://.
options.title: Server address

options.description: Full WebSocket URL for live updates, for example wss://zotero.example.org/stream or ws://zotero.example.org/stream. A path is allowed. Leave empty to derive it from the server address as wss://<server>/stream.
options.title: Streaming address (optional)

description: For development only. Plants Timber's debug tree so the app's own log lines reach logcat — expect a lot of output, and do not patch this into a build you rely on.
name: Enable verbose logging

description: Temporary workaround: the Zotero Android app discards an attachment whose stored modification time it cannot parse, instead of repairing it, so the file is never uploaded. Reported upstream: https://github.com/zotero/zotero-android/issues/351
name: Recover attachments with an unusable modification time

description: Erzwingt die Yospace-DAI-Entscheidung auf false, sodass der saubere, werbefreie Premium-Stream genutzt wird. Für RTL+-Premium-Abonnenten, die trotz Bezahlung Werbung erhalten.
name: RTL+ Werbung deaktivieren (Yospace DAI)

description: Forces the NYT Games home screen to use its lightweight static-icon card layout instead of the animated Rive cards. The Rive cards are embedded in the Compose list via AndroidView interop, whose per-item churn plus Rive TextureView compositing is the dominant UI-thread cost while scrolling — the reason busy home screens can't hold 120 fps. Cards stay fully functional; they just don't animate.
name: Optimize home screen (disable animated cards)

description: Let NYT Games render above 60 fps on 90/120 Hz and variable-refresh-rate displays. The app never opts into high refresh, so Android's power-saving frame-rate override pins it to 60 Hz; this makes each Activity window request the display's top refresh rate (a seamless, adaptive-refresh-friendly hint), lifting that cap.
name: Unlock high refresh rate

description: Disables all ad purchase checks to hide ads globally.
name: Remove Ads

description: Unlocks all premium features.
name: Unlock Premium

description: Unlocks all premium features by forcing all RevenueCat entitlements to active.
name: Unlock Premium

description: Forces the application to use the native Google Speech-to-Text engine instead of the third-party Soniox engine by disabling the Soniox realtime configuration.
name: Force Native Speech-to-Text

description: Unlock features like 'Web Access', 'Network' and 'FX Connect'.
name: Unlock FX Plus

description: Unlocks Nova Prime and all functions of the app.
name: Unlock prime

description: Unlocks the trial version.
name: Unlock trial

description: Remove ads, add VIP badge and allow to view 'Your Month in Review'.
name: Unlock pro

description: Replaces Samsung Account provider checks and routes account lookups through Android AccountManager.
name: Bypass Samsung Account provider checks

description: Bypasses Knox, root, warranty bit, and SAK checks so Samsung Health runs on Knox-tripped devices.
name: Disable Knox integrity checks

description: Strips the IllegalStateException + PassportRuntime handler block in c0.releaseRuntimeChecks (smali-aligned).
name: Bypass Passport signature mismatch crash

description: Sets android:debuggable=true on <application> (Passport allows non-Play signature on that path).
name: Debuggable application manifest

description: Unlocks the internal Maps-shell debug panel gate (Yandexoid prefs + swipable experiment).
name: Enable debug panel

description: Lets the image upscale screen take several pictures at once. Picking one works as before; picking more opens a screen that upscales them one after another with the upscaler and scale chosen there, where each result can be zoomed, compared with its original, and saved on its own or all together.
name: Batch upscale

description: Disables the Play Store license check, which a patched app always fails and which closes the app on launch. Needed by every patched build.
name: Disable Play license check

description: Drops the ANSI escape sequences JPTT's terminal emulator cannot parse, which otherwise swallow the screen content that follows them. Fixes the article list being stuck at 載入中, and keeps the next sequence PTT adds from breaking the app again.
name: Fix article list loading

description: Shows the picture for links an image host answers with a web page: an imgur album or .mp4, an address missing the i. subdomain, a meee.com.tw page. Only the preview and the full size image change, not the article text.
name: Fix image links

description: Fixes taking a photo to upload when the Clone app patch has renamed the package. Changes nothing on a normal install.
name: Fix photo upload in clones

description: Keeps the images of the article you are reading in memory, so they are not read again when you scroll back, and gives the memory back once the app has been in the background for a while. A disk cache behind it covers coming back after that.
name: Increase image cache size

options.description: Starting value for the memory the image cache may use while the app is open. 0 turns it off. Changeable in the app afterwards, under Settings > Morphe.
options.title: Image memory cache size (MB)

options.description: Starting value for how long the app may sit in the background before the image memory cache is emptied. Changeable in the app afterwards, under Settings > Morphe.
options.title: Release memory cache after (minutes)

options.description: Starting value for the maximum disk space the image cache may use. Changeable in the app afterwards, under Settings > Morphe.
options.title: Image disk cache size (MB)

description: Shows more of your recent search keywords in the article search dialog.
name: More recent searches

options.description: Starting value, changeable in the app afterwards. Recent keywords used on the board you are currently in. JPTT shows 5 of them.
options.title: 最近看板搜尋 entries

options.description: Starting value, changeable in the app afterwards. Recent keywords used on any board. JPTT shows 15 of them.
options.title: 最近搜尋 entries

description: Adds a tab to JPTT's own settings where the options these patches add can be changed without patching the app again, and where every setting can be exported to a file and read back.
name: Patch settings

description: Plays animated GIFs and WebPs in articles, which the app shows as their first frame. Needs Android 9 or later; the full size viewer still shows the first frame.
name: Play GIFs

description: Downloads an article's images as soon as you open it instead of when you scroll to each one. Respects the app's own image loading settings.
name: Preload article images

options.description: Starting value for how many of an article's images are downloaded ahead of time. Images past the limit still load the normal way when scrolled to. Changeable in the app afterwards.
options.title: Images to preload per article

options.description: Starting value for how many images are preloaded in parallel, changeable in the app afterwards. Fresco keeps a whole encoded image in memory for as long as its request is in flight, so raising this raises the peak memory use. Lower it if the app is killed on image heavy articles.
options.title: Images downloading at once

description: Reconnects the moment you come back to the app, instead of leaving you on a countdown that grows to eight seconds. While an article is open it waits until you leave it or do something that needs PTT, so opening links does not log you in again every time.
name: Reconnect on return

description: Stops the banner, the rows inside articles and lists, and the ad the app falls back to when it thinks AdMob is blocked. No ad is requested at all, so nothing is downloaded and nothing is reported.
name: Remove ads

description: Long press a recent search keyword in the article search dialog to delete it, clear the history, or add a home screen shortcut that opens the board with that search. Shortcuts made from the 最近搜尋 tab open the search too.
name: Search history actions

description: Shows PTT's message and stops when it temporarily bans the account from logging in, instead of sitting at 連線中 until the app is closed.
name: Stop on login ban

description: Lays the recent search keywords out over several lines instead of one line you have to scroll sideways.
name: Wrap recent searches

description: Enables the Google Phone call-recording eligibility check.
name: Call recording support

description: Removes the unavailable com.google.android.dialer.support shared-library requirement.
name: Remove Dialer Support Library

description: Makes the PairIP license check pass for sideloaded installs so the app no longer redirects to the Play Store and closes.
name: Bypass Play Store redirect

description: Disables Google Firebase Analytics tracking and removes Firebase Cloud Messaging push notifications.
name: Disable Firebase Analytics and FCM

description: Stops the app from reporting security breaches or APK integrity failures to the developers' Telegram channel.
name: Neuter Telegram security breach reporter

description: Removes the hard-coded OkHttp certificate pins and SSL pinning interceptor so the app trusts system and user CAs.
name: Remove certificate pinning

description: Disables the FLAG_SECURE window flag in the PDF and EPUB readers so screenshots and screen recordings are allowed.
name: Remove screenshot restriction

description: Adds a menu option that downloads, decrypts, and saves the book as a readable PDF or EPUB in the public Downloads folder.
name: Save book to Downloads

description: Unlocks premium features and removes ads.
name: CREX Premium

description: Injects the MicroG signature-spoof permission into Gemini's AndroidManifest.
name: GmsCore MicroG support

description: Replaces unused internal package names in Gemini's allowlist with Morphe-patched YouTube and YouTube Music package names.
name: Route intents to patched apps

name: Disable Analytics

name: Unlock Premium

description: Unlocks Sweepy Premium features.
name: Unlock Premium

description: Makes dark-theme page, app navigation and system bars pure black (AMOLED) while keeping elevated cards, sheets and controls gray so their boundaries remain visible.
name: AMOLED dark theme

description: Hides Avito offers from blacklisted adverts or sellers and adds a blacklist manager (import/export compatible with the Ave Blacklist extension).
name: Block listings

description: Stubs TBank's native RASP executor calls and neutralizes tamper flag reporting.
name: Bypass anti-tamper

description: Disables Adjust attribution manifest entry points.
name: Disable Adjust

description: Disables AppMetrica and legacy Yandex Metrica SDK entry points.
name: Disable AppMetrica

description: Disables AppsFlyer install referrer and attribution manifest entry points.
name: Disable AppsFlyer

description: Disables Firebase telemetry collection flags and DataTransport sender entry points.

description: Disables RuStore metrics manifest entry points.
name: Disable RuStore metrics

description: Disables Sentry telemetry by turning off SDK auto-init and clearing the DSN.
name: Disable Sentry telemetry

description: Disables Avito first-party clickstream analytics and Avito's direct Adjust telemetry wrapper.
